evidence.title: Multi Select · React motion component · beUI

name: Multi Select
summary: Composable multi-select React component with searchable options, animated tokens and a morphing panel.
description: Free open-source multi-select primitives for React and Next.js: searchable options with a filter function and keyboard navigation, selected values as removable animated tokens, and a collision-aware panel that morphs out of the trigger. Install with the shadcn CLI (shadcn add @beui/multi-select) or copy the source; parts include trigger, value, content, list, item, group and label.
contains: multi-select primitives: trigger, value, content, list, item, group, label
searchable options with a subsequence filter function
selected values as removable animated tokens
collision-aware panel that morphs out of the trigger
